example_coverage.scope: Predeclared diagnostic examples; not accuracy or recall.

semantic_retrieval.decision: Not added: bounded lexical retrieval found every predeclared difficult/example target; no demonstrated incremental benefit on this non-gold suite.

limitations: No human-labeled retrieval gold set exists; example coverage is not accuracy or recall.
Public descriptions are surrogate procurement text and contain overlapping extraction stages.
Fuzzy scores are ranking signals, not match confidence or identity decisions.
Token posting/pool caps can miss candidates with no useful lexical overlap.
Phase 4 does not compare critical attributes, reject conflicts, merge records or assign codes.
